question: Out of the following events, which event is NOT a part of Competitive Yogasana Sports?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Rhythmic Yogasana (Single)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rhythmic Yogasana (Single)** is not included as part of **Competitive Yogasana Sports**.
 
• Competitive Yogasana Sports focus on showcasing **strength, flexibility, balance, and artistic expression** through specific formats such as **Artistic Yogasana (Single & Pair)** and **Traditional Yogasana**.
 
• **Rhythmic Yogasana** is primarily associated with a synchronized flow of movements performed to music, emphasizing aesthetics rather than competitive scoring.
 
• It does not align with the standardized rules and scoring system defined for **Competitive Yogasana Sports**, which prioritize measurable physical performance.
 
• The formats of **Competitive Yogasana Sports** include specific poses, choreography, and techniques that adhere to globally recognized standards of competition.
 
• Exclusion of **Rhythmic Yogasana** ensures clarity in competition categories and avoids overlapping with other performance arts.
 
• The focus of Competitive Yogasana Sports is on poses and sequences that demonstrate the essence of traditional and artistic yoga practices rather than rhythm-based performances.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• ** Traditional Yogasana**__

 __
 
• **Traditional Yogasana** is a core component of Competitive Yogasana Sports, focusing on poses that are **rooted in classical yoga practices**.
 
• It emphasizes the **discipline of holding static postures** for a defined duration, showcasing stability and alignment.
 
• Examples of poses include **Padmasana, Chakrasana, and Sarvangasana**, which are integral to traditional yoga.
 
 
 
• **Artistic Yogasana (Single)**__
 __
 
• **Artistic Yogasana (Single)** involves a solo performance of yoga postures combined with **flowing movements and choreography**.
 
• It focuses on **grace, expression, and creativity** while maintaining the essence of yoga poses.
 
• This format is scored based on **presentation, difficulty, and execution**.
 
 
 
• **Artistic Yogasana (Pair)**__
 
 
• **Artistic Yogasana (Pair)** is performed in pairs, emphasizing **synchronization and coordination** between two participants.
 
• It includes choreography and poses that require **teamwork and balance**.
 
• This format highlights the harmony and interaction between participants, making it unique in Competitive Yogasana Sports.
